rationale: The assistant correctly identified F102 as a pyrolytic door-lock fault, asked the sensible door-closed/seal check first, and on hearing the power reset had been done and the oven was still in guarantee, properly steered the customer to AEG rather than a DIY part purchase. Nothing was invented and the escalation matches the ground truth exactly. Weaknesses are the garbled numbered list in the first reply with a fragment stating the lock 'has failed' as fact, no mention of the electronics alternative or advice not to keep retrying pyrolysis, and the 'high-voltage components' wording is slightly loose for a mains appliance.
